name: T'au Pathfinder Cadre
source: Mord Hive v0.5, pp.093-096 (T'au Pathfinder Cadre). Statlines from datasheets pp.094-095; equipment lists p.094; support systems / XV15 suit p.096; special skills p.096. Drones share one profile and differ only by cost/loadout (Spotter 35 tn, Shield 45 tn, Gun 55 tn) - modelled as a single Drone henchmen type with null cost, documented in notes; they attach to a model with a Drone Controller and don't count toward warband size. T'au/Kroot have no sourced racial-maximum profile (ceilings left null). TODO: verify Hero skill-table access - the p.093 checkmarks were ambiguous in the PDF extraction.

heroSlots.notes: Exactly one per warband. Only the Shas'vre may use the Damaged XV15 Stealth Suit (and only if an Earth Caste Engineer is in the warband). TODO: verify skill-table access.
NCOs who keep the warriors in line. TODO: verify skill-table access.
Support Technicians: a model may only use a Damaged XV15 Stealth Suit if an Earth Caste Engineer is in the warband. TODO: verify skill-table access.

henchmenTypes.notes: The largest group of stranded T'au. Bought in groups of 1-5. See Ta'Lissera (specialRules) for the bonding ritual / Monat rules.
Slower but more heavily armed. Bought in groups of 1-5.

A bit uncivilised: a Kroot may become a Hero (via the promotion rules) but may never be the Warband's Leader (unless it has Proto-Shaper), and a Kroot Hero never assists in exploration. Brutish: a Kroot Hero may learn Combat Skills instead of Shooting Skills. Bought in groups of 1-5.

VARIABLE COST - choose a type on purchase: SPOTTER (35 tn; enemy within 4" gain no cover benefit; may be up to 12" from owner), SHIELD (45 tn; models within 3" including itself are at -1 to hit from missile weapons), GUN (55 tn; +1 BS if it fires at the same target as its owner). One Drone per model with a Drone Controller; do not count toward warband size; never gain XP; must stay within 6" of their owner or count as stunned. Bought in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: Drones
specialRules.description: Do not gain XP. Must remain within 6" of their owner; if further at the start of their movement phase they count as stunned.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Damaged XV15 Stealth Suit
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Shas'vre only (needs an Earth Caste Engineer in the warband)
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Works as Carapace Armour; also +1 Strength and Movement up to 6" (may exceed racial maximum), and lets the wearer install 2 sub-systems instead of 1. (The p.094 list prices it at 140 tn; p.096 lists 150 tn.)

exclusiveEquipment.name: Drone Controller Sub-System
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Heroes only, one sub-system per model
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: May purchase a single Drone as part of its equipment; the Drone acts as a model but does not count toward the warband's maximum models.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Black Sun Filter Sub-System
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Heroes only, one sub-system per model
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: May discover hidden enemies at 4x the model's Initiative value.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Target Lock Sub-System
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Heroes only, one sub-system per model
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: No -1 to hit for moving and shooting; a Move-or-Fire weapon may now move and fire at -1 to hit.

specialRules: T'au Pathfinder Cadre. Ta'Lissera (Bonding Knife Ritual): when recruiting a non-Kroot Henchman group of 2+ warriors you may have them practise the Ta'Lissera (note it on the roster); that group may no longer buy new recruits. If a bonded group is reduced to a single model, that model becomes a Monat. Monat (Lone Warrior): gains Lone Warrior (immune to all Psychology) and Special Mission (may take any equipment from the list, including 'model only' items). Auxiliary Hosts: the T'au may hire any Hired Gun available (even faction-limited ones), except the most egregiously chaotic, and their initial hire fee is reduced by 20% (rounding up). | Only one sub-system per model (a Damaged XV15 Stealth Suit allows two). Min warband size 3, max 15. | T'au and Kroot have no sourced racial-maximum profile (ceilings left null).
